message.content:
I don’t have access to a live clock, so I can’t give you the precise current time right now.  
If you need the current time:

* On most computers/phones, look at the status bar (top‑right corner on Windows/macOS, bottom‑left on Android/iPhone).
* In a terminal or command prompt, run `date` (Unix/Linux/Mac) or `time /t` (Windows) to see the local time.
* If you’re coding, many programming languages offer built‑in libraries (`datetime.now()` in Python, `DateTime.Now` in C#, etc.) to retrieve the current timestamp programmatically.

Let me know if you'd like help formatting or converting times!
